independent_test_run.note: Re-run independently (not copied from TEST-RUNNER's report at test/reports/report-2026-08-26-WF02-REQ152-20260826.yaml). Also ran `mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` separately: clean, 125 files compiled, no warnings.

acceptance_criteria_check.ac: 1. test evaluates os.time/os.date/os.clock/os.difftime from inside a script, nil-or-raises
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: test/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox_test.exs describe 'REQ-152: os time functions raise when called (AC1)' lines 213-237: all four assert_raise Lua.RuntimeException ~r/sandboxed/.

acceptance_criteria_check.ac: 2. test asserts default denials (os.execute, load) still hold after the sandbox change
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: sandbox_test.exs describe 'REQ-152: default denials still hold ... (AC2, sandboxed-replaces-defaults trap)' lines 239-261, both via Sandbox.new/0 and new/1 with opts.

acceptance_criteria_check.ac: 3. test evaluates remaining 7 os functions (execute, exit, getenv, remove, rename, setlocale, tmpname), completing all 11
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: sandbox_test.exs describe 'REQ-152: remaining os functions ... (AC3)' lines 263-305 covers exit, getenv, remove, rename, setlocale, tmpname, execute -- combined with AC1's 4 and REQ-151's pre-existing os.execute/exit/getenv/remove/rename/tmpname tests, all 11 Lua 5.3 os functions are proven unreachable. Sandbox deny_set/0 (sandbox.ex lines 132-232) lists 33 entries including all 5 REQ-152 os additions (time, date, clock, difftime, setlocale).

acceptance_criteria_check.ac: 4. platform.now() from inside a script returns a string DateTime.from_iso8601/1 parses to UTC
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: platform_test.exs lines 36-49: asserts is_binary, DateTime.from_iso8601 success, dt.time_zone == "Etc/UTC". platform.ex now/0 (lines 65-72) shifts to Etc/UTC and calls DateTime.to_iso8601/1.

acceptance_criteria_check.ac: 5. time source injectable; test asserts one exact pre-set timestamp
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: platform.ex now/0 resolves Application.get_env(:letflow, :lua_platform_time_source, SystemClock) fresh every call (no direct DateTime.utc_now/0 at call site). platform_test.exs FixedTimeSource (lines 27-33) + describe 'the time source is injectable ... (AC5)' lines 52-90 assert exact match against ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00.000000Z], both via Platform.now/0 directly and via a script.

acceptance_criteria_check.ac: 6. moduledoc states LUA-14 restatement, 6-of-11 default deny gap, os.date/clock/difftime beyond-literal extension
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: sandbox.ex moduledoc lines 12-30 states the 6-denied/5-reachable finding by name (os.clock, os.date, os.difftime, os.setlocale, os.time) and 'goes BEYOND LUA-14's literal wording'. sandbox_test.exs 'REQ-152 moduledoc content (AC6)' lines 352-385 assert these strings plus the 28->33 count and the os.setlocale gap-closure note.

acceptance_criteria_check.ac: 7. moduledoc records platform.now is ungated by design per R-Co capability matrix
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: platform.ex moduledoc lines 14-28 states 'ungated by design', 'not an omission', 'no capability check, no gate', and names REQ-157 'by symmetry' explicitly. platform_test.exs 'moduledoc content (AC7)' lines 93-131 assert all of these substrings.

acceptance_criteria_check.ac: 8. mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted
